title: Jobbr: job parsing and resume matching demo
description: An interactive, browser-only demo of Jobbr's documented flow: synthetic job postings parsed into structured fields by transparent rules, then matched to a resume with an explainable score.
intro: Jobbr is a project that scrapes tech job postings, parses raw HTML into structured fields such as company_name, title, description, location, requirements, benefits and salary, and matches those postings to a candidate's resume.

This demo walks through that flow with fictional postings generated from a seed. Where the real project uses large language models to parse, the demo uses plain rules so every field and every score can be traced.

Paste a resume or use the sample, adjust the scoring weights, filter and sort the postings, and open any posting to see the raw text, the parsed fields, the rules that fired and why it scored the way it did.
features: Synthetic HTML-like job postings, deterministic per seed
Transparent rule-based parser with a visible rule trace
Resume text processed locally in the browser only
Deterministic match score with adjustable weights
Matched and missing skills explained per posting
Search, remote filter, minimum score and sorting
Illustrative scrape, parse and match pipeline view
demo_notice: All postings and the sample resume are synthetic. The demo runs entirely in your browser: it makes no network calls and sends nothing anywhere. Numbers are illustrative, not Jobbr metrics.
